messages.reason: Burn stuck IBC escrow tokens from dead Osmosis channel-1

title: Burn Stuck IBC Escrow Tokens
summary:
Burns ~599M MIRAGE stuck in the IBC escrow account for transfer/channel-1 (Osmosis).

The IBC client to Osmosis expired because Osmosis pruned the required historical data for light client verification. These tokens can never be recovered - they are permanently stuck.

This proposal burns those tokens to accurately reflect the actual circulating supply.

Escrow address: mirage1kq2rzz6fq2q7fsu75a9g7cpzjeanmk6877t950
